symbolic.rest_matrix_determinant: -C1*ct - C2*ct + bt1*q1**2 + bt1*q1*q2 + bt2*q1*q2 + bt2*q2**2 + ct*w
symbolic.scope: Homogeneous radial metric deformation, fixed composition, Gibbs relation and full diagonal quadratic entropy closure. A dynamical heat/temperature lift, not a fixed-entropy canonical heat coordinate or a full GR theorem.

native_initial_lift.scope: All saved native initial states, local reversible homogeneous metric deformation only. No spatial evolution, new EOS call or global well-posedness claim.

saved_paths.scope: Stored binary64 path states reconstructed with fresh native EOS/opacity; energy, entropy records and endpoint refinement checked. Does not independently recompute every nonlinear stage residual.
